linkedin_searches.query_name: Strict growth-core keywords + startup consumer-tech companies
linkedin_searches.reasoning: High-precision: forces core growth skills + limits to known consumer-tech companies.

linkedin_boolean_search.keywords: ("user acquisition" OR retention OR "funnel" OR "growth marketing" OR "lifecycle" OR "performance marketing") AND (A/B OR "data driven")
linkedin_boolean_search.company: Amazon OR Flipkart OR Swiggy OR Zomato OR Razorpay OR CRED

linkedin_searches.expected_profiles: Core growth managers within top consumer-tech startups.

linkedin_searches.query_name: Broad growth keywords (no company filter) – recall-first
linkedin_searches.reasoning: Casts widest net across all startups and consumer apps; no company filter.

linkedin_boolean_search.keywords: (growth OR "user acquisition" OR retention OR lifecycle OR "performance marketing" OR funnel)

linkedin_searches.expected_profiles: Growth managers, analysts, lifecycle, retention, UA across all tech startups.

linkedin_searches.reasoning: Targets people whose title includes growth/UA/retention variants; adds company filter.

linkedin_boolean_search.job_title: (Growth OR Acquisition OR Retention OR Lifecycle OR Performance)
linkedin_boolean_search.company: Meesho OR Nykaa OR Ola OR Uber OR PhonePe OR Razorpay

linkedin_searches.expected_profiles: Startup growth managers whose title explicitly references growth or UA.

linkedin_searches.query_name: Product-growth leaning profiles (broad) – no company filter
linkedin_searches.reasoning: Captures candidates from product-led teams (common in consumer tech).

linkedin_boolean_search.keywords: ("product growth" OR "growth analytics" OR "growth experiments" OR "A/B testing" OR funnel OR "user acquisition")

search_strategy.reasoning: Growth roles vary heavily in title; keywords best capture work: user acquisition, retention, funnel optimization.
search_strategy.coverage_approach: Mix strict/broad, job-title-led vs keyword-led, and company-filter vs no-company-filter.

queryConstructorResult.coverage_assessment: The four queries balance strict vs broad, keywords vs job-title emphasis, and include both company-filter and no-company-filter variants. High recall and strong coverage of all growth-role title varieties across consumer-tech startups.
